csv_project_name: AE for MRRL-Youth Services Interior Redesign
csv_scope_of_work: Missouri River Regional Library (MRRL) seeks a qualified design firm to provide professional planning and full design consultant services for the redesign of the interior Youth Services space of the Main Library on 214 Adams in Jefferson City, Missouri. The project should encompass the complete redesign of the above square footage suitable for ages 0-17 years of age, utilizing creative design elements and interactive areas while maintaining access to materials and seating for both children and their families/caregivers.
